lessons.trigger: A therapeutic candidate is audited or re-audited.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use a distinct inference context, pass only the exact artifact plus minimum authorized evaluation context, and mechanically prohibit producer or modifier self-certification.
lessons.failureCondition: A role prompt in the producer context is accepted as independent, hidden producer context crosses the firewall, or producer_context_id equals auditor_context_id.
lessons.repairAction: Reject the audit and invoke a fresh context with a sealed minimum audit packet.

lessons.trigger: A runtime turn is persisted, restored, fails, or transitions.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Every nonfinal state names a valid next controller action or an explicit terminal operational failure; restore reconciles and resumes that frontier.
lessons.failureCondition: A turn is nonfinal with no executable action, stale approval is treated as delivery authority, or a provider failure silently becomes completion.
lessons.repairAction: Reconcile persisted state and resume or expose the explicit fail-closed boundary.

lessons.source: current owner instruction + existing PR 49 candidate lifecycle
lessons.trigger: Candidate text is created, audited, repaired, approved, or delivered.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Bind every transition to immutable candidate ID, version, exact text digest, lineage, and context identity; never inherit approval after text changes.
lessons.failureCondition: An audit of vN approves vN+1, changed bytes retain approval, or delivered bytes differ from approved bytes.
lessons.repairAction: Block delivery, invalidate the stale transition, and audit the exact current version in a fresh context.

lessons.source: current owner instruction + existing PR 49 two-cycle cap
lessons.trigger: An exact-version audit returns a substantive failure.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Persist the failure, create at most two immutable repairs in separate producer contexts, require repair-induced-error checks, then route unresolved uncertainty to a minimal discriminator.
lessons.failureCondition: Failure evidence is overwritten, a third repair is created, or the final failure has no discriminator frontier.
lessons.repairAction: Restore the audit record and transition to the discriminator boundary.

lessons.trigger: A provider response cannot be invoked, parsed, or validated.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Persist operational attempt evidence privately, retry only within the fixed transient budget, and never classify malformed output as a substantive therapeutic fail or deliver the candidate.
lessons.failureCondition: Parser cleanup is silently admitted, retry budget expands, or an operational error causes unaudited delivery or repair.
lessons.repairAction: Keep the current semantic frontier unchanged and expose an explicit fail-closed operational state after retries exhaust.

lessons.trigger: Runtime turns and public repository work occur concurrently.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep real messages, longitudinal state, candidate/audit/delivery content, and private-derived hashes solely in the private store; public artifacts remain generic and synthetic.
lessons.failureCondition: Git, CI, logs, or PR prose contains real private content or a private-derived digest.
lessons.repairAction: Block publication, remove disclosure from candidate history, and rerun the publication audit.

lessons.source: global working agreements + current owner coordination
lessons.trigger: The real Louka v3 lifecycle is being produced in another work task against PR 49.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Develop generic runtime changes in the isolated worktree, make no real-case mutation, then integrate the other task's durable commit with explicit overlap review.
lessons.failureCondition: This task edits the dirty shared checkout, races the private mutation, or asks the owner to shuttle results.
lessons.repairAction: Stop the conflicting write, restore isolation, and reconcile only from committed durable state.
